card.name: Inside antibiotic and drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name, mainly the 'ycin' in erythromycin and the 'x' in moxifloxacin, in warning text about antibacterials. It also fires on a few other drug or term pieces such as diltiazem and deferasirox.
